walkthrough.short: Pass right shoulders with {pairs}, slide back to back, then back up passing left shoulders, {amount}.
walkthrough.long: Walk forward and pass right shoulders with {pairs}, slide across back to back without turning, then walk backward to place passing left shoulders. Nobody takes hands and nobody turns around: you face the same way for all eight beats. Go {amount}. {where}

walkthrough.short: Robins only. Pass right shoulders in the middle, slide back to back, and back up to place, {amount}.
walkthrough.long: Robins only. Walk forward and pass right shoulders in the middle, slide across back to back without turning, then walk backward to place passing left shoulders. Nobody takes hands and nobody turns around, and the larks stand on their places. Go {amount}. {where}

walkthrough.short: Larks only. Pass right shoulders in the middle, slide back to back, and back up to place, {amount}.
walkthrough.long: Larks only. Walk forward and pass right shoulders in the middle, slide across back to back without turning, then walk backward to place passing left shoulders. Nobody takes hands and nobody turns around, and the robins stand on their places. Go {amount}. {where}
